summary: St. Louis County, MN: 80-foot ladder tower erected 1934 for the Minnesota Forest Service; removed 1989, possibly over vandalism. No source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Built and removal dates come only from the county survey and the statewide A-Z list, which appear to draw on the same survey notes, so they are not independent. No narrative source on staffing, fires or the site was found. The centraluslookouts page gives only the county and township-range-section (55N-21W-30) and no status.
